weaknesses.title: TOPKEY is algebraic max not magnitude
weaknesses.detail: On signed drift api:2 edge:-9 TOPKEY picks api. Biggest mover needs ABSKV first. Easy paging miss for large regressions.

weaknesses.title: Non-numeric fields survive DROPZERO/ABSKV/SIGNKV
weaknesses.detail: note:hello kept through all three ops; SIGNKV may leave string while POS/NEG/ZERO ignore it. Direction plates contaminate.

weaknesses.title: DROPZERO only exact 0; THRESHKV min1 drops negatives too
weaknesses.detail: Correct distinction but agents confuse DROPZERO with denoise-flat-and-neg. Document: DROPZERO keeps falls, THRESHKV drops them.

weaknesses.title: ABSKV_N counts only fields that flipped sign
weaknesses.detail: ABSKV_N=2 when two negatives became positive; zeros and positives not in N. Agents may think ABSKV_N==LINES means full bag.

weaknesses.title: No SIGNKV-only-pos / filter by sign form
weaknesses.detail: Want KEEP POS after SIGN without THRESHKV on original. Must THRESHKV source or GREP dir plate.

weaknesses.title: No combined MAGRANK / TOPABS primitive
weaknesses.detail: Biggest-mover needs DROPZERO+ABSKV+TOPKEY glue every agent. MEANINGFUL_ITER candidate TOPABSKV.

workarounds: Always ABSKV before TOPKEY on signed deltas
DROPZERO for flat clean; THRESHKV min1 for rise-only
Use SIGNKV_POS/NEG for pulse; ignore ZERO for bias
Compare ABSKV_N to count of negatives not total lines
issues_faced: TOPKEY signed trap confirmed high-sev for fleet paging
Non-numeric preserve across all three new ops
